fullPrompt:

A 2x2 grid of four completely separate small illustrations on a plain white background. Wide clean white gutters between them, each drawing sitting well inside its own quarter, nothing crossing or touching between the cells, no grid lines, no borders, no frames. TOP LEFT: A woman almost hidden behind a stack of books taller than her head, the top three books sliding off the front of the stack and falling, her chin clamped down on the stack trying to stop them, seen from low down so the stack towers over the viewer. TOP RIGHT: A woman whose paper grocery bag has split open along the bottom, oranges and a baguette dropping out around her feet, both arms clamped underneath the bag to hold what is left, looking down at the mess, seen from the side. BOTTOM LEFT: An armful of loose unfolded laundry with no basket and no bag, piled so high it covers the carrier's face completely, a sock hanging off the top and a sleeve trailing along the floor behind her, only her legs visible below the pile. BOTTOM RIGHT: A man carrying four stacked cardboard boxes up a narrow staircase, the top box tilting off to one side as he leans away from it, one foot feeling for the next step he cannot see past the boxes, seen from above and behind.
